descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a senior relationship manager with a strong commercial drive and an established network in Lebanon? Do you consistently deliver high-quality advisory to sophisticated clients and generate sustainable business growth? We are looking for a Relationship Manager to cover HNW/UHNW clients in the Near East segment who will:
• Build, develop and grow a portfolio of HNW/UHNW clients, with a strong focus on Lebanon and the broader Near East region
• Leverage an established personal network to drive new client acquisition and increase market share in the target segment
• Deliver holistic, high-quality investment advice in close collaboration with investment specialists and product partners
• Define and execute a structured client development plan with clear revenue and NNM objectives
• Maintain a thorough understanding of client profiles, investment suitability and portfolio performance
• Act as a first line of defense by ensuring full compliance with regulatory requirements and promoting a strong risk culture
